title.zh: Circle’s Noble shutdown leaves Cosmos racing to move $92 million in USDC
title.en: Circle’s Noble shutdown leaves Cosmos racing to move $92 million in USDC

current_state.zh: Circle will stop minting USDC on Noble in October, forcing Cosmos to migrate roughly $92 million in stablecoin liquidity and integrations to Injective before a January redemption deadline.
current_state.en: Circle will stop minting USDC on Noble in October, forcing Cosmos to migrate roughly $92 million in stablecoin liquidity and integrations to Injective before a January redemption deadline.
